items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: But Lottie Gee, and Margaret Simms, and Charley Davis went home from somewhere there.

ctx.x: And all this time, the show was still intact, pretty much.

Yeah. And we didn't -- it broke up, when did that show break up. I mean it didn't break up. But Lottie Gee, and Margaret Simms, and Charley Davis went home from somewhere there. And Adelaide Hall, the Three Eddies. But we added some people who were the stragglers in Europe, and sent and got some people. That's when Mabel Mercer and some people from England joined the show, you know.
Oh, Mabel Mercer did come in with the show?
